stem.text: Which statements correctly describe an oxide of nitrogen acting as an atmospheric pollutant?

items: Nitrogen monoxide, $\text{NO}$, reacts with oxygen to form nitrogen dioxide which contributes to acid rain.
Nitrogen dioxide reacts with sulfur dioxide to form sulfur trioxide which reacts with water to form sulfuric acid.
Nitrogen oxides react with unburnt hydrocarbons in sunlight to form other pollutants.
